name: Hamza Bencheikh
headline: Computer Science engineering student
bio:
I'm a 4th-year Computer Science engineering student at INSA Lyon, and what drives me is the models themselves: their architecture, and how to make them more efficient so they need less energy and compute while staying useful.

Next year I plan to join KTH in Stockholm for a double degree to specialise in machine learning, and I then aim for a PhD in the field. I want to bring that work into the companies I join: models that cost less to run and deliver more.

In summer 2026 I interned at Delta Quest in Sapporo, Japan, in an international team working in English, where I designed generative AI workflows and an evaluation pipeline. Alongside my studies, I build projects with ETIC INSA Technologies for clients such as VINCI and Inddigo.

I'm looking for an AI / LLM engineering internship of up to four months from May 2027, abroad, in a team that challenges me intellectually and where I can put my first AI and machine learning skills into practice.
